release.body:
**Bitcoin Commons BLVM** — Bitcoin Low-Level Virtual Machine node CLI.

> [!NOTE]
> Verify your download against `checksums.sha256` before running.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Linux x86_64** (binary) | `blvm-0.1.5-linux-x86_64` | Full features |
| **Linux x86_64** (Debian/Ubuntu) | `blvm_0.1.5_amd64.deb` | dpkg install |
| **Linux x86_64** (RHEL/Fedora) | `blvm-0.1.5-1.x86_64.rpm` | rpm install |
| **Windows x86_64** | `blvm-0.1.5-windows-x86_64.exe` | Core features |
| **Checksums** | `checksums.sha256` | SHA-256 for all artifacts |

## Verify

```bash
sha256sum -c checksums.sha256
```

## Install

**Linux (binary):**
```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.1.5/blvm-0.1.5-linux-x86_64
curl -LO https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.1.5/checksums.sha256
sha256sum -c checksums.sha256
chmod +x blvm-0.1.5-linux-x86_64
sudo mv blvm-0.1.5-linux-x86_64 /usr/local/bin/blvm
```

**Debian/Ubuntu:**
```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.1.5/blvm_0.1.5_amd64.deb
sudo dpkg -i blvm_0.1.5_amd64.deb
```

**RHEL/Fedora:**
```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.1.5/blvm-0.1.5-1.x86_64.rpm
sudo rpm -i blvm-0.1.5-1.x86_64.rpm
```

**Windows:** Download `blvm-0.1.5-windows-x86_64.exe`, verify checksum, and run from a terminal.

## Changes

See [commit history](https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/compare/205c1fced75180e8570663c91c4d1c3722a4030b...1542e11f49c633be7bea9228677a0aea8a0ee731)

page.title: Install blvm
page.lead: Pre-built Linux packages (.deb / .rpm) from GitHub Releases, with checksums.sha256 published on each release. Verify before running.

packages.label: Debian / Ubuntu
packages.description: Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 11+, and any dpkg-based distro.
packages.installCmd:
sudo dpkg -i blvm_0.1.5_amd64.deb
sudo apt-get install -f    # pull in any missing deps

packages.label: Fedora / RHEL
packages.description: Fedora 38+, RHEL 9, CentOS Stream 9, and RPM-based distros.
packages.installCmd:
sudo rpm -i blvm-0.1.5-1.x86_64.rpm
# or via dnf:
sudo dnf install ./blvm-0.1.5-1.x86_64.rpm

platforms.name: Umbrel
platforms.description: Available in the Umbrel App Store as "Bitcoin Commons". Runs on a Raspberry Pi or any Linux machine with a one-click node stack.
steps: Open your Umbrel dashboard and go to the App Store.
Search for "Bitcoin Commons" and click Install.
Wait for initial sync to complete; this may take several hours on first run.
Access node settings and RPC credentials from the app detail page.

platforms.name: Docker
platforms.description: Run blvm in a container on any platform that supports Docker or Podman. Official image tagging follows blvm releases when published.
steps: Pull the image: docker pull btccommons/blvm:0.1.5
Create a persistent data volume: docker volume create blvm-data
Run the node: docker run -d --name blvm -v blvm-data:/data -p 8333:8333 -p 8332:8332 btccommons/blvm:0.1.5
